events.title: Ski Lines joins Steam Next Fest! ⛷️
events.summary: We're joining Steam Next Fest! 🎉Hello everyone!Big news! Ski Lines is taking part in Steam Next Fest, October 19–26!If you've ever dreamed of designing your own ski resort, now's your chance! Build pistes, connect ski lifts, manage your mountain, and try to keep your skiers happy as your resort grows.The free demo is available to play, and we've prepared a fresh patch to make your time on the slopes even better!Patch 0.2.1 — Smoother slopes ahead!This update focuses on a few improvements inspire

events.title: The Mountain Comes Alive
events.summary: This update adds a whole bunch of new scenery elements to Ski Lines.Rocks, barriers, cliffs, chalets, rivers and plenty of other obstacles can now be found across the different maps.But they are not just here to look pretty.They will also make planning your resort a little trickier. events.title: Patch 0.1.1

events.title: Controller, Sunlight, Freedom
